hammerclient.title: Hammer Client
hammerclient.tip.0: Right Shift opens the Hammer module panel.
hammerclient.tip.2: In the module panel click "Edit HUD" and drag elements with the mouse.
hammerclient.tip.3: Join our Discord – giveaways, help and news.
hammerclient.tip.4: F2 takes a screenshot – find it in the launcher's Gallery.
hammerclient.tip.5: The launcher's Optimisation tab picks RAM and mods for more FPS.
hammerclient.menu.title: Hammer Mods
hammerclient.menu.subtitle: Mods and settings – click a card to switch it
hammerclient.editor.title: HUD editor
hammerclient.editor.hint: Drag elements with the mouse · Esc – save
hammerclient.module.cps.desc: Clicks per second – left and right button.
hammerclient.module.ping.desc: Latency to the server in milliseconds.
hammerclient.module.speed.desc: How fast you move (blocks per second).
hammerclient.module.keystrokes.desc: Lights up W A S D, mouse and space.
hammerclient.module.memory.desc: How much memory the game uses.
hammerclient.module.potions.desc: Active potion effects with time left.
hammerclient.module.day.desc: Which day it is in the world.
hammerclient.module.zoom.desc: Hold C to zoom in smoothly.
hammerclient.module.togglesprint.desc: Sprint switches on with one press and stays on.
